key.name: round-libadwaita-apps
key.summary: Round libadwaita apps like any other app

key.name: round-libhandy-apps
key.summary: Round libhandy apps like any other app

key.name: round-maximized
key.summary: Keep maximized and tiled windows rounded
key.description: They get no shadow. Fullscreen windows stay square.

key.name: use-whitelist
key.summary: Use the whitelist instead of the blacklist

key.name: blacklist
key.summary: Desktop IDs of the apps that are not rounded

key.name: whitelist
key.summary: Desktop IDs of the only apps that are rounded

key.name: blacklist-categories
key.summary: Toolkits whose apps are not rounded

key.name: whitelist-categories
key.summary: Toolkits whose apps are rounded with the whitelist

key.name: styled-apps
key.summary: Desktop IDs of the apps with a style of their own
key.description: Each style is stored under apps/ID/.

key.name: styled-categories
key.summary: Toolkits whose apps share a style of their own
key.description: Each style is stored under categories/TOOLKIT/. Toolkits: libadwaita, libhandy, chromium, firefox, java, qt, gtk4 and gtk3.

key.name: custom-style
key.summary: Use this style instead of the next one
key.description: An app's style comes first, then its category's, then the general one, then libadwaita's style and gtk.css.

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius in pixels

key.name: outline-width
key.summary: Width of the outline inside the window's edge, in pixels

key.name: outline-color
key.summary: Color of the outline
key.description: A CSS color such as rgb(255,255,255) or #ffffff. Color names are not read.

key.name: outline-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the outline

key.name: shadow-angle
key.summary: Direction the light comes from, in degrees
key.description: Counter-clockwise from the right. The shadow moves the other way.

key.name: shadow-distance
key.summary: How far the shadow is moved, in pixels

key.name: shadow-blur
key.summary: Blur of the shadow, in pixels
key.description: Of libadwaita's main shadow layer. Its other layers follow in proportion.

key.name: shadow-color
key.summary: Color of the shadow
key.description: A CSS color such as rgb(0,0,0) or #000000. Color names are not read.

key.name: shadow-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the shadow
key.description: Of libadwaita's main shadow layer. Its other layers follow in proportion.

key.name: border-method
key.summary: How the app's own border is hidden
key.description: off leaves it, extend paints over it with the pixels next to it, and clip cuts it off.

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Width of the app's own border, in pixels
